seoTitle: Add Product Reviews to Shopify With Ali Reviews
metaDescription: Install the Ali Reviews app and import feedback from AliExpress, Amazon, Etsy, eBay, DSers, and Temu into Shopify for free, then match it to your theme.
intro: The Ali Reviews app is a common way Shopify sellers pull genuine reviews from multiple marketplaces into one store. This guide covers installing the app, importing reviews for free from sources like AliExpress and other platforms, and customizing the widget so it matches your Shopify theme with star ratings and photos.

steps.heading: Install the Ali Reviews app
steps.body: Add the Ali Reviews app to your Shopify store from the app store as the starting point for importing reviews.

steps.heading: Import reviews for free from AliExpress and other sources
steps.body: Connect the app to product listings on AliExpress, Amazon, Etsy, eBay, DSers, or Temu and import their reviews without paying extra.

steps.heading: Customize the reviews display on product pages
steps.body: Adjust the look and feel of the review widget so it fits your Shopify theme rather than looking bolted on.

steps.heading: Apply final tips for boosting sales
steps.body: Once reviews are live, use star ratings and photos strategically on your product pages to help build trust and improve conversions.

faq.question: Is Ali Reviews free to use for importing?
faq.answer: Yes, this guide covers importing reviews for free using the Ali Reviews app, without paid add-ons required for the import itself.

faq.question: Which marketplaces can I import reviews from?
faq.answer: You can import from platforms including AliExpress, Amazon, Etsy, eBay, DSers, and Temu.

faq.question: Will the reviews match my Shopify theme?
faq.answer: Yes, the app lets you customize the widget's look and feel so it matches your store's theme.

faq.question: Is this method for beginners or advanced users?
faq.answer: It works for both beginners and experienced Shopify users who want to improve trust and sales.
